context.body: Noah enters a genealogy through his father’s expectation before the narrative reports anything Noah does.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Lamech names his son Noah while speaking of work, painful toil, and the ground the LORD cursed.
observations.label: Lamech names Noah in hope of comfort: action

observations.body: The genealogy then names Noah as father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
observations.label: Lamech names Noah in hope of comfort: response

observations.body: Noah · comfort us · toil of our hands · cursed ground
observations.label: Words in Genesis 5:28–32

payload.posture: Read Genesis 5:28–32 as name and world evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The name carries an expectation, but the passage does not explain how or when that expectation will be fulfilled.
payload.title: Lamech names Noah in hope of comfort
